2105-5895-6965-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-5895-6965-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-5895-6965-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

240-2438-5470-8201.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

602-4691-5014.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.

Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Putrid Imp ability, giving Putrid Imp flying until end of turn
Repeat

3430-5137-6723.description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Morphling by paying {U}, untapping it.

997-1278-3327-4508.easyPrerequisites: Lightning-Rig Crew doesn't have summoning sickness.
997-1278-3327-4508.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least two artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
997-1278-3327-4508.description:
Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo by paying {R} due to its cost reduction, including its commander tax.
Lightning-Rig Crew triggers, untapping it.
Resolve Dargo. Then, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.

When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

When the Phyrexian Germ enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Phyrexian Germ.
Repeat from step 2.

When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.

Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.

Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.

Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.

Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia's first ability triggers, creating two Foods and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the two Foods by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

Resolve the Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

Utopia Sprawl attached to Izzet Boilerworks.

Animation Module triggers for each +1/+1 counter placed this way.

Repeat from step 1.

524-3606.description:
Cast Aether Storm.
Players can no longer cast creature spells, and Aether Storm can not be destroyed due to players being unable to pay life to activate its ability.

1385-2178-4283-4314.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Whisper.
Whisper does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two other nontoken creatures.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
1385-2178-4283-4314.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping it and sacrificing two other nontoken creatures.
Pawn of Ulamog, Zulaport Cutthroat and Whisper each trigger twice.
Resolve both Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Resolve both Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain two life.
Resolve both Whisper triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Whisper ability from step 1, returning target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Whisper by tapping it and sacrificing an Eldrazi Spawn token and any other nontoken creature.
Pawn of Ulamog triggers once, while Zulaport Cutthroat and Whisper each trigger twice.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Repeat from step 4.

On each opponent upkeep activate Isochron Scepter to cast Orim's Chant targeting the player who's turn it is, preventing them from casting spells that turn.
Seedborn Muse untaps both Isochron Scepter and the mana required to activate it each turn.
Teferi, Time Raveler prevents your opponent from playing spells at instant speed before you are able to cast Orim's Chant or in response to Orim's Chant.
You may also pay the kicker cost to prevent them from attacking.

813-1283-1987-2427.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.

When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.
